hooks.name: Content Guard
hooks.description: Scan saved component files for hard-coded names, dates, phones, or event names that belong in wedding.ts.

action.command: node -e "const i=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const d=JSON.parse(i);const f=d.file||'';if(!f)process.exit(0);const src=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8');const patterns=[/\"Ankita\"|\"Avnish\"|'Ankita'|'Avnish'/,/\+91\d{10}/,/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/,/(Haldi|Mehndi|Sangeet|Reception|Phere)/];const labels=['Hardcoded name','Hardcoded phone','Hardcoded date','Hardcoded event name'];let found=false;patterns.forEach((p,idx)=>{const m=src.match(p);if(m){console.error('CONTENT-GUARD ['+labels[idx]+']: \"'+m[0]+'\" found in '+f+' — move to src/content/wedding.ts');found=true;}});if(found)process.exit(1);"
